statuses.name: Poison
statuses.description: Deals 10% maximum HP damage every round, to a maximum of 3*LV damage.
statuses.notes: Menov's Fang amplifies this effect. Glykin, Dullahan and Snakemen are immune to Poison infliction.

statuses.name: Lingering Damage
statuses.description: Take damage that ignores protection every round equal to LV based on element.
statuses.notes: Multiple Lingering Damages can exist at once, if their element type is different from each other.

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.description: Deals protection-ignoring Fire damage every round equal to LV. Negates Bonus DEF.
statuses.notes: Salamandra and Drowned Woman are immune to Burn infliction.

statuses.name: Frozen
statuses.description: Reduces Evade to 0 and prevents movement skills while active. Damage reduces LV; 0 ends status. Can struggle to reduce the LV.
statuses.notes: Grants 2 rounds of immunity after recovery.

statuses.name: Soaked
statuses.description: +15% Fire Res, -10% Lightning Res. When taking Lightning damage, Soaked allies within 1 Range also take the damage. Ice and Earth damage replaces with a different effect.
statuses.notes: The replaced effects are: Immobilized (Ice), Muddy (Earth).

statuses.name: Charm
statuses.description: Reduces damage dealt to the target by LV%. May take damage for the causer if near them.
statuses.notes: If the causer deals any direct damage, it reduces the duration of Charm on their target (you). Shaitan are immune to Charm infliction.

statuses.name: Flatfoot
statuses.description: You are flat on your feet. -5 Evade and -1 Move until your next turn.

statuses.name: Strangling Etacof
statuses.description: Hex. Prevents Silence from being cured and causes it to deal 5% HP and FP damage every round.
statuses.notes: Max. 50 Darkness damage, and 25 FP reduction.

statuses.name: Llunel's Decay
statuses.description: Hex. Prevents Interference from being cured and causes it to instead reverse regeneration into damage.
statuses.notes: Regeneration status effects also become reversed, such as Refreshing Flow.

statuses.name: Hellflame Uorate
statuses.description: Hex. Prevents Burn from being cured and causes it to nullify bonus RES the target has.

statuses.name: Menov's Fang
statuses.description: Hex. Prevents Poison from being cured and causes it to deal 1.5x damage.

statuses.name: Imagin's Despair
statuses.description: Hex. Prevents Fear from being cured and increases all damage taken by 10%.
statuses.notes: This affects Damage over Time effects.

statuses.name: Stun
statuses.description: Turn is skipped, but damage taken is reduced by 50%. Ends afterwards. Taking resisted damage might end the status early and let you act with 3M.
statuses.notes: Bosses cannot be stunned. Grants 2 rounds of immunity after recovery.

statuses.name: Knocked Down
statuses.description: Must spend 3M getting up during your next turn.
statuses.notes: Kip-Up, Roc's Rise and Quick Rise mitigate the momentum needed. Grants 2 rounds of immunity after recovery.

statuses.name: Badly Beaten
statuses.description: Obtained after reviving. Reduces your base Momentum recovery at round start by LV.
statuses.notes: The status worsens if you are revived multiple times while under its effect.

statuses.name: Immobilize
statuses.description: Cannot use Move or Movement Skills.
statuses.notes: Grants 2 rounds of immunity after recovery.

statuses.name: Grappled
statuses.description: Treated as immobilized until the causer's next turn.
statuses.notes: If the causer or victim are moved, the effect ends.

statuses.name: Slow
statuses.description: -LV Move.
statuses.notes: This only affects basic movement.

statuses.name: Clumsy
statuses.description: Movement skills, aside from basic movement, are disabled.
statuses.notes: Grants 2 rounds of immunity after recovery.

statuses.name: Muddy
statuses.description: 15% chance to be slip and be knocked down after using Movement. Chance increases by 15% for every tile moved beyond class base Movement speed.
statuses.notes: This will also interrupt your Move attempt right where you've been knocked down.

statuses.name: Frostbite
statuses.description: Inflicts protection-ignoring Ice damage every time you walk on an Ice Sheet.
statuses.notes: The Ice Sheet must break for this to happen. LV = Damage.

statuses.name: Thorn Wrap
statuses.description: Inflicts protection-ignoring Pierce damage to the target when they use a Movement skill.
statuses.notes: This also works on basic Movement. LV = Damage.

statuses.name: Attract Objects
statuses.description: Pulls enemy traps and bombs LV tiles towards yourself at the start of a new round.

statuses.name: Guard Break
statuses.description: The character's guard has been broken. They temporarily take 15% more damage, cannot Guard, and Parry skills will automatically fail.
statuses.notes: Requires the opponent to be Guarding. This effect ends on their next turn.

statuses.name: Certain Defeat
statuses.description: At the start of a new round, this unit's HP becomes 0.
statuses.notes: If you are revived, you can still act before round is over.

statuses.name: Airborne
statuses.description: In the air, dude.
statuses.notes: A myriad of skills interact with this status effect, but it does nothing by itself.

statuses.name: Claret Call
statuses.description: Increases physical damage caused by the causer.
statuses.notes: Only increases the damage of Basic Attacks and Ghost skills.

statuses.name: Needle
statuses.description: Upon taking Light damage from any source but Needle, explodes, taking Light damage equal to LV and heals allies of the causer that are within 2 Range for the same amount.

statuses.name: Solar Lance
statuses.description: That can't be good.
statuses.notes: Upon taking any Fire or Light damage, it explodes next turn, dealing 100% of the causer's Fire ATK as protection-ignoring Fire damage.

statuses.name: Analyze Weakness
statuses.description: Increases all damage suffered by LV%.
statuses.notes: Affects Damage Over Time effects too.

statuses.name: Hunted
statuses.description: Increases damage taken from the causer by LV%.
statuses.notes: Affects Damage Over Time effects too.

statuses.name: Hesitation
statuses.description: LV% chance to hesitate when attacking.
statuses.notes: This only affects Basic Attack or skills that use Basic Attacks. Shaitan are immune to Hesitation infliction.

statuses.name: Sneezed On
statuses.description: You were sneezed on... ew. -10% Status Resistance.
statuses.notes: You gain this effect if you're a Kaelensia and someone with Animal Allergy is nearby during combat.

statuses.name: Fear
statuses.description: -15 Hit VS Causer.
statuses.notes: Shaitan are immune to Fear infliction.

statuses.name: Goose Bite
statuses.description: Reduces all stats by LV.

statuses.name: Drain
statuses.description: Reduces all stats by LV.
statuses.notes: This will also increase the causer's status by LV.

statuses.name: Blotch
statuses.description: Decreases Hit by LV.

statuses.name: Wear Down
statuses.description: Reduces Armor by LV.

statuses.name: Rampage
statuses.description: Decreases DEF by LV.

statuses.name: Cursed Wound
statuses.description: Lowers maximum HP by LV.

statuses.name: Soul Chains
statuses.description: Prevents FP recovery as if it were Interfered. Treated as being Installed uniquely.
statuses.notes: Interference reduction effects apply to this.

statuses.name: Acidity
statuses.description: Reduces Phys. Defense and Mag. Defense by LV%.

statuses.name: Black Drain
statuses.description: Power drained by an enemy. Lowers Scaled Weapon Attack equal to LV.
statuses.notes: This also applies from non-damaging skills from Soldier.

statuses.name: Glowing
statuses.description: Evade is reduced by LV.

statuses.name: Magnetize
statuses.description: Increases the causer's Hit when attacking you by LV (max 50).

statuses.name: Pacify
statuses.description: Cannot use basic attacks or Offensive skills. Taking non-status, non-bonus damage will reduce its duration by 1 round.
statuses.notes: This will only be seen used on Monsters, usually.

statuses.name: Spelldaze
statuses.description: Once acquired, puts a random spell you have equipped on a 2 round cooldown. Cannot be reapplied while active.
statuses.notes: Cooldown timer cannot be reduced below the original cooldown duration.

statuses.name: Enemy Evaluation
statuses.description: Decreases Hit, Critical, Evade, and damage dealt by LV%.

statuses.name: Confusion
statuses.description: Cannot differentiate between friend and foe.
statuses.notes: This prevents you from targeting allies with supporting or healing skills.

statuses.name: Blind
statuses.description: Final hit chance is capped at 50%.
statuses.notes: Kaminah Robes turn this effect into Beyond Sight, which has a lesser impact on your hit chance.

statuses.name: Interference
statuses.description: Prevents recovery of HP and FP.
statuses.notes: This also prevents revive effects.

statuses.name: Silence
statuses.description: This character is silenced and cannot cast spells.
statuses.notes: Grants 2 rounds of immunity after recovery.

statuses.name: Removed From Battle
statuses.description: Removed from the battle while this status is active.
